entries.text: Claude dot com runs on a tinted cream canvas, with warm coral for every call to action and dark navy for the product itself.
Coral is the signature accent. A full bleed coral card is the highest voltage move the brand makes.
Display headlines run a slab serif at weight four hundred, with negative tracking. Body type is a humanist sans. The pairing reads as a considered publication, not a software template.
